build_DINOTxt_model: build a DINOTxt model with a DINOTxtConfig for vision-language contrastive learning
create_DINOTxtConfig: create a DINOTxtConfig dataclass to configure embed dimension and vision and text backbone settings
encode_image_with_patch_tokens: encode an image tensor into features and patch tokens using DINOTxt encode_image_with_patch_tokens
encode_text: encode a text tensor into normalized embeddings using DINOTxt encode_text method
get_logits: compute image-to-text and text-to-image contrastive logits using DINOTxt get_logits method
